title: 2022 Annual Report: World Health Organization, The Gambia
why_not: Its DHIS2 facts are of 2022 and of the COVID-19 tracker (internet subscriptions for data clerks in 50 of 76 facilities), a noted class; the costed plan it names is the health sector plan 2021-2025, not one naming the HMIS, and nothing is dated since October 2023.
